Detailed Steps: 1. Log in with a user that has active membership. 2. On the left sidebar click "Orders". 3. Click "Purchase Orders" (you may need to expand Orders first). 4. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Purchase Orders page should open. 2. You should see either a list/table of purchase orders OR an empty state with a button like "Create Purchase Order". 3. The URL should contain "orders" and "purchase". 4. No blank screen or infinite loading.
Allowed roles: COMPANY_ADMIN (company list); any portal role (store list)

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Orders > Purchase Orders when there are no purchase orders yet.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should load. 2. You should see an empty state or message (e.g. "No purchase orders"). 3. A "Create Purchase Order" or similar button should be visible.
Allowed roles: COMPANY_ADMIN (company list); any portal role (store list)

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Orders > Purchase Orders. 2. Click the "Create Purchase Order" button (usually at the top or in the empty state). 3. Wait a moment.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A pop-up (modal) should appear. 2. The modal should contain a form with fields to create a purchase order (e.g. supplier, items, quantities). 3. There should be a Submit/Save button and a Cancel or X button.

Detailed Steps: 1. Click Create Purchase Order so the modal opens. 2. Optionally type something in a field. 3. Click Cancel or the X to close the modal (do NOT submit).
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The modal should close. 2. No new order should be created. 3. The list (if any) should be unchanged.

Test Case: Create Purchase Order - submit with required fields
Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Create Purchase Order modal. 2. Fill in all required fields (e.g. select supplier, add at least one item with quantity). 3. Click Submit or Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The modal should close. 2. A success message should appear. 3. The new purchase order should appear in the purchase orders list (or the list should refresh). 4. You may be taken to the order detail or stay on the list.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Create Purchase Order modal. 2. Leave required fields empty (e.g. do not select supplier or add items). 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should not submit. 2. Validation messages should appear (e.g. "Please select a supplier" or "Add at least one item"). 3. No order should be created.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Create Purchase Order. 2. Add a line item but enter a negative number (e.g. -5) or zero (0) for the quantity. 3. Try to submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should show a validation error (e.g. "Quantity must be greater than 0"). 2. The order should not be created until the quantity is valid.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Purchase Orders list click on an order (row or view icon).
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A detail view or page should open. 2. You should see the order information: supplier, items, quantities, dates, status, etc. 3. The data should match what was entered when the order was created.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a purchase order that is in "Draft" status (if your app allows editing drafts). 2. Click Edit. 3. Change one or more fields (e.g. quantity or add an item). 4. Click Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A success message should appear. 2. The order details should show the updated data. 3. When you view the order again, the changes should be there.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to Orders in the sidebar. 2. Click "Sales Orders" (or "New Order" / Sales). 3. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Sales Orders page should open. 2. You should see a list of sales orders OR an empty state with a "New Order" or "Create Sales Order" button. 3. The URL should contain "orders" and "sales".
Allowed roles: COMPANY_ADMIN (company list); any portal role (store list)

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Orders > Sales Orders when there are no sales orders.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The page should load. 2. You should see an empty state or message. 3. A "New Order" or "Create Sales Order" button should be visible.
Allowed roles: COMPANY_ADMIN (company list); any portal role (store list)

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Sales Orders page click "New Order" or "Create Sales Order". 2. Wait for the form to appear.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A modal or form should open. 2. You should see fields to create a sales order (e.g. customer, items, quantities). 3. There should be Submit and Cancel options.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Create Sales Order form. 2. Click Cancel or X to close without submitting.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should close. 2. No new sales order should be created.

Test Case: Create Sales Order - submit with required fields
Detailed Steps: 1. Open the Create Sales Order form. 2. Add at least one item (product and quantity). 3. Select customer if required. 4. Fill any other required fields. 5. Click Submit or Save.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The form should close. 2. A success message should appear. 3. The new sales order should appear in the sales orders list.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Create Sales Order. 2. Do not add any items or leave required fields empty. 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Validation messages should appear (e.g. "Add at least one item" or "Customer is required"). 2. No order should be created.

Test Case: Create Sales Order - add and remove line items
Detailed Steps: 1. Open Create Sales Order. 2. Add one line item (product + quantity). 3. Add another line item. 4. Remove one of the line items (using Remove or delete icon). 5. Submit the order.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The order should be created with only the remaining line item(s). 2. The totals or summary should match the items you kept. 3. No errors should occur.

Detailed Steps: 1. On the Sales Orders list click on a sales order.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The order detail view should open. 2. You should see customer, items, quantities, amounts, status. 3. Data should match the order.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a sales or purchase order that can change status (e.g. Draft to Submitted). 2. Find the button or action to change status (e.g. "Submit" or "Confirm"). 3. Click it and confirm if asked.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The order status should update (e.g. from Draft to Submitted). 2. The status shown on the list and detail should reflect the new status. 3. You may see a success message.

Detailed Steps: 1. Create a sales order and add an item with a quantity greater than the available stock (e.g. product has 5 in stock, enter 10). 2. Try to submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system may show a warning or error (e.g. "Insufficient stock"). 2. Behavior may allow or block the order depending on business rules. Note the actual behavior in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Create Sales Order (when customer is required). 2. Do not select a customer. 3. Add items and try to submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A validation error should appear (e.g. "Please select a customer"). 2. The order should not be created until a customer is selected.

Test Case: Sales Order - scan to add item (barcode or type + Enter)
Detailed Steps: 1. Create or open a Sales Order in a status that allows adding items (e.g. Draft or Open). 2. On the order detail page find the scan area (e.g. "Scan barcode here" or a text field with "Add Item" button). 3. Type a product item barcode or QR code value (or use a barcode scanner and scan a product item). 4. Press Enter or click "Add Item". 5. Wait for the response.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. If the barcode is valid and the item is in stock: the item should be added to the order line items and the order totals should update. 2. You may see a short success or the new line appear in the list. 3. If the product item requires a quantity (unit-based): a pop-up may ask you to enter the quantity; enter it and confirm. Then the item should be added with that quantity. 4. If the barcode is invalid or not found: an error message should appear and no line should be added. Note behavior in Spotted Problems.

Detailed Steps: 1. On a sales order detail page use the scan field. 2. Type a random or invalid code (e.g. "INVALID123"). 3. Press Enter or click Add Item.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The system should show an error (e.g. "Product item not found" or "Invalid barcode"). 2. No new line should be added to the order. 3. The order should remain unchanged.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to Finance in the sidebar. 2. Click "Payments". 3. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Payments page should open. 2. You should see a list of payments (or empty state). 3. The URL should contain "finance" and "payments". 4. No blank screen or infinite loading.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Finance > Payments. 2. Click on a payment in the list (or View).
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The payment detail page should open. 2. You should see payment number, amount, payment method, date, invoice link, and option to Create Receipt or View Receipt.

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to a Sales Order detail that has an invoice linked (or go to Finance > Invoices and open an unpaid invoice). 2. Click "Make Payment" or "Create Payment". 3. In the payment form enter amount, payment method (e.g. Cash, Card), and date. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The payment should be created and linked to the invoice. 2. You should see a success message. 3. The invoice's amount paid or payment status should update (e.g. Partial or Paid). 4. From the payment detail you should be able to Create Receipt.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open Create Payment from an invoice. 2. Leave amount or required fields empty (or enter invalid amount). 3. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Validation errors should appear. 2. No payment should be created until the form is valid.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to Finance > Invoices. 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Invoices page should open. 2. You should see a list of invoices (or empty state). 3. The URL should contain "finance" and "invoices".

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Finance > Invoices. 2. Click on an invoice in the list.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The invoice detail page should open. 2. You should see invoice number, order link, line items, totals, payment status, and list of payments. 3. If unpaid or partial, a "Create Payment" or "Make Payment" button should be visible.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a Sales Order that is confirmed/completed and does not yet have an invoice. 2. Click "Create Invoice" (or similar). 3. Fill in issue date, due date, and any required fields. 4. Click Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The invoice should be created and linked to the sales order. 2. You should see a success message. 3. On the sales order you should now see "View Invoice" instead of Create Invoice. 4. The invoice should appear in Finance > Invoices.

Detailed Steps: 1. Log in and go to Finance > Receipts. 2. Wait for the page to load.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The Receipts page should open. 2. You should see a list of receipts (or empty state). 3. The URL should contain "finance" and "receipts".

Detailed Steps: 1. Go to Finance > Receipts. 2. Click on a receipt in the list.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The receipt detail page should open. 2. You should see receipt number, payment link, invoice link, amount, payment method, and issued date. 3. Option to Print Receipt if available.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a Payment detail that does not yet have a receipt. 2. Click "Create Receipt". 3. Confirm or fill any required fields. 4. Submit.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. The receipt should be created and linked to the payment. 2. Success message should appear. 3. On the payment page you should now see "View Receipt" instead of Create Receipt. 4. The receipt should appear in Finance > Receipts.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open an invoice detail page. 2. Click "Print Invoice" or Print button.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. A print preview or PDF should open (or the browser print dialog). 2. The printed content should show invoice details (number, line items, totals). 3. No error should occur.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a payment detail page. 2. Click "Print Payment" or Print.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Print preview or dialog should open with payment details. 2. No error.

Detailed Steps: 1. Open a receipt detail page. 2. Click "Print Receipt" or Print.
Detailed Expected Result: 1. Print preview or dialog should open with receipt details. 2. No error.
